title: "Interactive Visualization Template"
subtitle: "Reference deck — not camp content"

## How to use this deck {.smaller}

This deck is a reference/template, not session material. It shows the
pattern for embedding a live, canvas-based interactive visualization
directly into a revealjs slide so it always fits within the slide, no
matter how much text sits above it:

-   A unique wrapper class (`.viz-sinewave` below) that every CSS rule and
    DOM query is scoped under, combined with the shared `.viz` class that
    caps the whole block at 45% of the viewport height and lays controls +
    canvas out as a column flexbox
-   The `<script>` wrapped in an IIFE so its variables/functions never
    become globals
-   A canvas with **no hardcoded height** — it's sized in JS from its own
    rendered box (`clientWidth`/`clientHeight`), which the `.viz` flexbox
    determines, so it exactly fills whatever space is left under the
    controls

See `slides/slides.css` for the shared convention notes and the `.viz`
layout rules this relies on.

## Live example: amplitude slider {.smaller}

```{=html}
<div class="viz viz-sinewave">
  <div class="viz-sinewave-controls">
    <label for="viz-sinewave-amplitude">Amplitude: <span class="viz-sinewave-readout">50</span></label>
    <input id="viz-sinewave-amplitude" type="range" min="10" max="100" value="50" step="1">
  </div>
  <canvas class="viz-sinewave-canvas"></canvas>
</div>

<style>
.viz-sinewave { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; }
.viz-sinewave-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 0.4em; }
.viz-sinewave-controls input[type="range"] { flex: 1; }
.viz-sinewave-canvas { display: block; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var container = document.querySelectorAll('.viz-sinewave');
  container = container[container.length - 1];

  var canvas = container.querySelector('.viz-sinewave-canvas');
  var slider = container.querySelector('#viz-sinewave-amplitude');
  var readout = container.querySelector('.viz-sinewave-readout');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
    canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
  }

  function draw() {
    var amplitude = Number(slider.value);
    readout.textContent = amplitude;

    var w = canvas.width;
    var h = canvas.height;
    var midY = h / 2;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, midY);
    ctx.lineTo(w, midY);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b6cb0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var x = 0; x <= w; x++) {
      var y = midY - amplitude * Math.sin((x / w) * 4 * Math.PI);
      if (x === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function refresh() {
    resize();
    draw();
  }

  slider.addEventListener('input', draw);
  window.addEventListener('resize', refresh);

  // The slide holding this canvas may be hidden (clientWidth/Height === 0)
  // when this script first runs, since reveal.js only lays out the active
  // slide. Re-measure every time reveal.js navigates so the canvas is
  // sized correctly the first time this slide actually becomes visible.
  if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.on === 'function') {
    window.Reveal.on('slidechanged', refresh);
    window.Reveal.on('resize', refresh);
  }

  refresh();
})();
</script>
```
